scope_statement: Independent bounded-completeness study of established Workflow Management: representation, coordination and enactment of control/data/resource/interaction semantics, human and external work, exception, recovery, change and evidence. Evolved names a criticism-tested analytical synthesis, not an academic school.
scope_boundaries: No requester repository, prior Evolved packet or sibling corpus was inspected. No target-specific adoption, architecture mutation or release judgement.
Business-process organisational management and process-mining inference are documented interfaces, not substituted for the lane’s enactment question.
Not a census of every commercial engine, publication, legal regime or scientific domain; product evidence is edition/implementation-specific.
Formal guarantees are confined to stated model classes; social authority, physical effects, fairness and scientific truth are not inferred from model state.
No bulk copyrighted source texts, credentials, private logs or unrelated material included in the packet.

saturation_rationale.BASIS: Decision saturation within the declared scope, not a fixed number of sources, properties, search rounds or time budget.
WHAT_CHANGED_LATE: The revised control-flow report changed the count/assumption treatment and triggered an explicit recursion-progress counterexample.
ActionWorkflow added commitment/acceptance candidate EWM-077 rather than being discarded after the initial register.
CMMN terminal-state semantics prevented all-child-success from being silently built into closure.
2025 field slides sharpened observation/denominator limits; 2026 static studies remained insufficient for a general autonomous-safety claim.
Composition created EWM-075 and EWM-076 with explicitly analytical status.
saturation_rationale.WHY_STOP_HERE: Every mandatory domain and named major branch has inspected support or a disclosed evidence-limit disposition. Further equivalent overviews do not alter the current mechanisms or selection guards. The unresolved general optimisation claim requires materially different prospective/independent evidence, not more repetitions of the same preprints; inaccessible originals remain visible limits rather than hidden gaps.
saturation_rationale.NOT_CLAIMED: Exhaustive bibliographic coverage, universal empirical saturation, certainty about unobserved systems or a completely settled critical literature.
FUTURE_REOPEN_TRIGGERS: New counterexample to a retained scoped mechanism or composition guard.
Lawful access to the original critique or missing empirical methods that changes an adjudication.
Independent prospective evidence for agentic safety/benefit or flexibility selection.
Materially changed execution/standard version used by a later target.

uncompleted_burdens_explanation: No mandatory family or registered candidate is left NOT_EXAMINED. Open questions and source access limits are examined uncertainty and are listed separately; they are not represented as completed empirical proof.
independence_policy: Common author programmes, datasets, experimental systems and industrial programmes are labelled in SOURCE_TABLE.INDEPENDENCE_CLUSTER and the evidence cards. A citation or edition is not an independent replication.
